parameters.content:
## WDFOX cenník → PostgreSQL + Qdrant (TEST)
Import as NEW workflow. Manual trigger only.
1. Select the same PostgreSQL credential in BOTH Postgres nodes (database n8n, host postgres). Only schema wdfox_test is touched.
2. Select OpenAI API credential in Embed node. API usage is billed separately from ChatGPT.
3. Qdrant nodes use internal Docker DNS qdrant:6333. If API-key protection is enabled, configure an n8n HTTP Header credential api-key in ALL 3 Qdrant HTTP nodes. Never paste secrets into JSON.
4. Run manually; require report indexed_services=10. Re-runs reuse stable IDs, no duplicates.
Pricebook version is immutable: conflicting rows are not overwritten; use a NEW version for price changes. No production deploy, payment, invoice or external webhook.
